findings.before: Family/Type and Revision absent; input Approved/Baseline 1.0.
findings.proposal: Add Family Foundation, Type Architecture because the primary role is design-decision rationale and principles, not chronology alone. Omit invented Component/Class. Retain original contribution/history; first changed successor Draft/unassigned, Revision 1.
findings.closure_criterion: Header reflects primary responsibility; actual compatibility determines Version; no Revision 0 or renewed approval inferred.

findings.before: Technical update no longer affected administrative properties; none of the consumers need technical content; knowledge resides exclusively in content, although 5.14 also locates knowledge in relationships.
findings.proposal: Keep conceptual separation of content and descriptors but distinguish it from physical separation or independent edition changes. Identity owns identity; Metadata represents descriptors. Technical edits may require edition/status/index updates; content-sensitive reviews or relationship evidence may inspect content. Describe knowledge entities, descriptors and relationships without mutually exclusive claims or competing semantic owners.
findings.closure_criterion: No absolute administrative independence or content-free consumer guarantee remains; descriptor/domain authority and exact-edition coupling are explicit; 2.12 and 5.14 are coherent.
findings.related_records: REV2-06; REV2-08; FND004-04 (earlier local closure retained)

findings.before: Splitting/merging grouped with renaming as only representation changes; Registry dependent exclusively on identity; every document assumed to possess permanent identity.
findings.proposal: Distinguish rename/relocation from semantic split/merge, requiring explicit retained/new identities and provenance rather than assume same knowledge. Scope normalized identity away from excluded functional files. Identity is the logical key, while entries/consumers may require edition, location and owner contracts. Preserve IDs across ordinary version/reclassification; no unplanned allocations.
findings.closure_criterion: Split/merge does not silently reuse one identity for distinct successors; rename and edition evolution retain valid identity; functional exclusion and key-versus-full-record distinction explicit.
findings.related_records: REV2-04; REV2-09; INV-02 remains Not applicable

findings.before: Registry does not duplicate information and does not represent relationships; Knowledge Graph describes relationships and its introduction completed Discovery; Relationships owner is absent.
findings.proposal: Distinguish authoritative typed Relationships records from Registry references/derived indexes and Knowledge Graph projections. Non-redundancy means one semantic authority with traceable edition provenance, not a physical single-copy rule. Preserve historical emergence but do not describe Registry/Graph as all current Discovery capabilities.
findings.closure_criterion: Relationship ownership and permitted projections explicit; no exclusive graph or physical no-copy contract; current Discovery overview does not omit other registered responsibilities.

findings.before: Baseline a set of documents; always a validated state; stability enough for creation; graph state preserved without exact-edition selection, approval and pinned context.
findings.proposal: Define collective snapshot of explicitly selected immutable document editions plus relevant pinned relationship context/evidence. Distinguish logical identity, Version/Revision, edition Status and Baseline; validate selection and require explicit approval/inclusion per policy. Research phases may be selected only when criteria are satisfied. Preserve old snapshots; do not infer membership from edits, validation or current paths.
findings.closure_criterion: Members resolve to exact editions; validation is distinct from approval/selection; changed Draft successors do not alter past membership; no automatic whole-graph or research-phase snapshot assumed.

findings.before: Eight unlabeled arrow views; components rely on Baselines and vice versa without required-contract scope; neither project depends architecturally on the other despite provider/consumer relation.
findings.proposal: Type every view as historical activity, conceptual association, selection or principle map. Mandatory dependencies use consumer-to-provider with contract/scope; distinguish navigation, snapshot context and external optional consumption. Do not relabel a genuine required cycle to hide it. Qualify partial adoption by required provider contracts; DF independence from VisualEngine does not imply consumers require no DF contracts. Preserve eight view IDs and correct dr9-1 eparation typo during UPDATE.
findings.closure_criterion: All eight views have explicit meanings/direction; required edges separate from chronology/reference; no blanket independence or unsupported global DAG/cycle claim.

findings.before: Knowledge/Representation/Governance/Discovery/Preservation called layers; Metadata assigned Representation and Baselines Preservation.
findings.proposal: Retain historical concern rationale but distinguish five conceptual concerns from seven structural areas. Use Documentation for primary Metadata allocation and Governance for Baselines; Preservation cross-cutting, not a new structural Layer/component. Reference Architecture responsibility and qualify pending six/seven source discrepancy.
findings.closure_criterion: All chapter 7 allocations distinguish conceptual concerns and structural primary allocation; Baselines Governance; no invented Knowledge/Preservation structural areas.
findings.related_records: REV2-01; INV-04; FND004-02 (earlier local closure retained)

findings.before: Final architecture, implemented Baselines, graph immediately identifies impacts, components functioned correctly and architecture now sufficiently mature without supplied verification evidence.
findings.proposal: Preserve received historical assessments as such; distinguish intended capability, architectural rationale and implementation/validation evidence. Qualify immediate/completeness claims and do not invent dates, measures, approval or operation results.
findings.closure_criterion: No unqualified present operational maturity or immediate impact-analysis guarantee; received assessments traceable with explicit current evidence limits.

findings.before: Related documents referenced only by title; current-versus-history owner map absent.
findings.proposal: Add a concise actual-path map for Blueprint, Manifest, Framework Evolution, Research Journal, Evolution Timeline and affected owners/policy/report. Identify rationale versus chronology/specification roles; links do not create mandatory execution dependencies.
findings.closure_criterion: Links resolve to intended IDs; historical/current roles distinct; no unrelated owner source is silently updated or external specification invented.

result: REVIEW complete with seven findings and two warnings; source unchanged; UPDATE/VALIDATE not performed
